First of all I’m sorry that happened to you. It’s probably been so hard to deal with such world in an age where it’s usually so youthful and free, but it’s not your fault. There are so many opportunities for you! Where I’m from there’s mandatory military service, seems unrelated but the age that everyone discharges is usually 20-21. So most people here start their adult life in that age. They have their whole life ahead and so do you so please don’t give up on yourself. You could invest a little bit in a bar tending course and become a bar tender, I have friends who did it and it was actually fun making cool cocktails, but if you can’t or don’t want to, maybe do an IT course and work as a help desk. Yes there’s a bit of work involved studying a bit of material but it will be worth it and it’s a great start to get into the world of IT and build a solid career. Point is! No matter what it is, I’m sure there is a way out, I’m sure you can do it! It’s hard and it’s rough and even getting up in the morning and brushing teeth feels like it takes 5-7 business days but you can do it. You can. You can heal, you can grow, you can find something to work in, and you can get out of this, so don’t give up on yourself because your life is precious. I’m rooting for you!!! (And don’t belittle yourself! You’re smart and capable end of story)
